subject: SOC 2 re-attestation: retention window change + license top-up
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finvara.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@finvara.com
Date: Mon, 02 Jun 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 re-attestation: retention window change + license top-up

Hi Vivek,

We are starting our SOC 2 re-attestation for the July audit window and realized we need to update a couple of things on the contract side before we proceed. Two asks from our security & procurement teams: 

1) Retention/Log window: we need 13 months of audit log retention (up from 90 days) for our account. This is across API request logs and syslog exports. Can Redwood support this retention and outline any storage or throughput implications?

2) License/Seats: our usage has grown; Procurement is asking for a +4 seat top-up to our Dedicated plan (current committed seats = 10). Please provide a swift amendment with pricing and any pro-rated billing for June/July.

Attached is a short scope note from our security team (Finvara_SOC2_scope_changes_v1.pdf) and an initial evidence manifest. Ideally we want the retention change effective July 1 and seats active as soon as contract amendment is signed.

Can you put together an amendment and a short runbook of what evidence we'll need for the recert? If there's a dependency on a private onramp or extra ingest pipelines for retention, flag that.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Turner
CISO, Finvara
alex.turner@finvara.com

-----Original Attachment: evidence_manifest_20250602.xlsx (attachment stub)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finvara.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Jun 2025 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation: retention window change + license top-up

Alex — thanks for the clear asks. We can support both, but there are a few items to confirm so we provide an accurate amendment and timeline: 

- Retention: 13 months is possible via our archival retention tier. Two follow-ups: do you require immediate immutable retention (WORM) for the 13 months or standard read/write archival with tamper-evident audit? The former will affect storage pricing and lead time for KMS/HSM policy updates.

- Ingest/throughput: if you plan to keep full request logs (high QPS), we should validate expected daily log volume so we can size the ingestion pipeline and retention buckets. Please share a 14-day sample or estimated GB/day.

- Seats: we can add 4 seats. We'll include pro-rating from the amendment effective date. I'll draft a simple contract amendment (term: maintain current names; pricing: list + pro-rate; operational: seats active on sign).

Marissa, Kimberly — looping you in for the evidence/runbook and redlines. Ben — please review if there's any billing caveat for prorated charges if the effective date is in the middle of the billing cycle.

Action items: 
- Alex: send expected daily log volumes or sample (can be a CSV) and confirm WORM vs standard archival.
- Marissa: draft evidence runbook and retention implementation steps.
- Kimberly/Ben: prepare pricing amendment and pro-rate calc for +4 seats.

I'll target a draft amendment + runbook by Wed (2025-06-04).

Best,
Vivek
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@finvara.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation: retention window change + license top-up

Thanks Vivek & Alex — I pulled the compliance plan together and attached a short runbook and evidence checklist. Summary below: 

1) Retention implementation options
- Option A (recommended): Archival tier with tamper-evident checksums + KMS-managed keys (standard). Storage delta estimated at ~45GB/day -> ~18TB for 13 months.
- Option B (WORM): Immutable retention with HSM policy. Adds ~12% to storage cost and requires a 2-week KMS policy lead time.

2) Evidence we need from Finvara (examples)
- List of external IP allow-lists for audit log egress
- Representative logs for a 14-day window (compressed CSVs)
- SOC 2 attestation scope confirmation and the list of user roles requiring token-level audit

3) Operational steps & timeline (target July 1 effective)
- 06/04: Finalize amendment redline (Sales & Legal)
- 06/06: Procurement sign & DocuSign return
- 06/10: Engineering begins retention bucket provisioning and KMS policy update (if Option B: allow 2 weeks)
- 06/14: Ingest pipeline validation with 14-day sample
- 07/01: Retention policy enforced; seats incremented upon billing trigger

Attached: evidence_runbook_finvara_v1.pdf (runbook) and an initial cost delta spreadsheet (evidence_manifest_20250602.xlsx).

Questions for Alex: 
- Can you confirm preferred retention option (A vs B)? If you pick B, we need an additional signature for KMS/HSM changes.
- Can procurement confirm the exact pro-rate month preference (bill at signing vs bill at effective date)?

Marissa Cole
Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

-----Attachment: evidence_runbook_finvara_v1.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finvara.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@finvara.com
Date: Thu, 05 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation: retention window change + license top-up

Thanks Marissa — the runbook looks solid. A few quick items: 

- We will choose Option A (tamper-evident archival with KMS-managed keys) to avoid the KMS lead-time for WORM.
- Daily log volume: approximately 32GB/day compressed (14-day sample to follow by EOD).
- Procurement confirms they prefer billing pro-rated at signing. Please include a one-time invoice for the seat top-up pro-rate.

If you can send the redlined amendment and the DocuSign link, Procurement will route it today. We need seats active by 06/10 if possible for an upcoming load test.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Alex
